levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن أبي عبد الله

notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ عَبْدُ اَلرَّحْمَنِ» : the asker is written first; «سأله» points at the one asked, who is taken from prev1 (rule 5, owner ruling on al-Faqih openings)

prev1 (1995) writes its chain «رَوَى عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»: its last name is the Imam, taken over as the last link. «عقبة بن خالد» is the transmitter of prev1, not of this report: not inherited
